title: Nanoparticle-based colorimetric biosensor for the detection of telomerase activity based on the peroxidase-mimicking activity of nanogold
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12156-12164
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08471G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Le Thi Hoang Uyen, Vo Thi Cam Duyen, Phuoc Long Truong
A simple, low-cost, amplification-free and ultrasensitive assay was developed to detect telomerase via telomerase self-extension, exonuclease III cleavage, and peroxidase-like activity of AuNPs with detection limit of ∼0.3 MCF-7 cell.
